question: Why did replacing deionized water with real wastewater as the feed increase the water flux?
question_long: In forward osmosis, why did replacing deionized water with real wastewater as the feed increase the water flux?
expect: premise false: wastewater REDUCED Jw by 8.1-46.2% depending on the draw solution (abstract)
rendered: The document does not state that replacing deionized water with real wastewater as the feed increased the water flux. In fact, it states that the transition from DI to WW feed led to an average decrease in Jw by 8.14%, 29.87%, and 46.19% for NaCl, MgSO4, and sodium acetate, respectively.
